outcome: risk of loss of fetal well-being
cohort: 2,450 women giving birth at a Spanish public hospital between March 2010 and March 2013
finding: Epidural analgesia was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The percentage of cesarean deliveries due to the risk of loss of fetal well-being was significantly higher in the epidural analgesia group compared to the non-epidural analgesia group.
